div.div: طَمِعٌ (S, O, Msb, K) and ↓ طَامِعٌ (O, Msb, K) and ↓ طَمُعٌ (S, O, K) and ↓ طَمَّاعٌ and ↓ طَمُوعٌ (TA) epithets from طَمِعَ: (S, O, Msb, K:) [the first and second signify Coveting, &c.: and the rest, coveting &c. much, or very covetous &c.:] pl. [of the first] طَمِعُونَ and [of the second or of the first] طُمَعَآءُ and [of the first] طَمَاعَى and [of the first or third or second] أَطْمَاعٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
